title: Tom Clancy's The Division: New York Collapse
summary: Alex Irvine's licensed Division companion frames post-Black Friday New York through an in-universe urban-survival guide and a survivor's annotations, establishing April Kelleher's story before Broken Dawn.

claims.text: Ubisoft announced New York Collapse as Alex Irvine's official Division companion: an urban-survival field guide set against post-Black Friday New York City.
Its official published framing combines a pre-collapse guide with handwritten notes and accounts from a lone survivor investigating the collapse.
Ubisoft later identifies April Kelleher as New York Collapse's protagonist and describes Broken Dawn as continuing her story into the period before The Division 2.

paragraphs.text: New York Collapse is official Division transmedia, but it is neither a game mission nor a real-world emergency manual. Ubisoft presents it as a fictional urban-survival field-guide format rooted in the post-Black Friday New York setting.

The guide's annotated survivor frame makes it a useful source-specific entry point for April Kelleher. Ubisoft's later Broken Dawn material explicitly carries her story forward, while this archive retains only high-level, independently written continuity context rather than reproducing book pages, annotations or artifacts.

verification.notes: Official Ubisoft material establishes the work, its high-level framing and its connection to April Kelleher. Public archive text is original summary only; it contains no prose, cover art, scans, OCR text, removable artifacts or downloadable edition.
